feature: Native Troll full Turtle customizations extension

decisions.fixed_faces: One atlas-authored fixed face aliased across normal male Face0..4 / female Face0..5. Preserves Face byte during skin cycling; not distinct authored faces. DK-exclusive faces remain native.
decisions.atlas_sampling: 256-square source expanded to 512 with deterministic nearest-neighbor, no invented interpolation; crops in native 512 atlas coordinates.
decisions.underwear: Six native body/underwear pairs fit U=alpha*F+(1-alpha)*B. Largest 4-connected alpha>=0.5 region, 3x3 dilation, snap below0.05/above0.95. Approximate recovered cloth composited on matching body crops; original Base0 stays byte-exact; pre-baked garments retained.
decisions.facial_alpha: True separate 8-bit alpha; no black/white keying. Original BLP2 bytes except the two explicitly listed malformed terminal-mip sources, regenerated as full encoding3 BGRA mip chains with pixel-exact top RGBA. DK hair colors10/11 alias8 and12 aliases9, not newly authored palettes.
decisions.hair: Only PLAYER bit added to117 native Base3 rows: male6..9/female5..9, normal flags0x12->0x13, DK0x06->0x07.
decisions.alias: Male source109 equals accepted Forest body20000/color18 byte-for-byte; no duplicate color.
decisions.scope: Only CharSections, CharacterFacialHairStyles, accepted162 BLPs and new textures. No models, CharHairGeosets, races, classes, spells or crypt assets.
decisions.names: Numbered alternates and shop1/2 stay opaque; only zombietrollshop has an explicit zombie source name. NPC colors6..14 are not enabled.
